$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0. A suggested way forward for property packs in England. One worked proposal - not a standard, and endorsed by nobody.
title: Rule result
description: The JSON twin of rule-result.ts. An explainable determination: where an implementation applies a rule, it returns its working. uncertain is a first-class status, not a failure.

because.description: The evidence trail. Never empty: a determination that cannot show its working is a verdict.

legalStatus.description: The legal status of the rule itself.

asOf.description: The moment the determination was made.

ruleStatus.title: RuleStatus
ruleStatus.description: A closed vocabulary: adding a token is a MAJOR change.

fieldPath.description: The path of the field the rule read.

observed.description: The value the rule observed there. May be null: an absent value is evidence too.
